statement: For every integer c>5 with c!=7, Conjecture 50 of arXiv:2609.05358v1 holds for the subtraction game S={2,5,c}. More precisely, the source-proved residues 1,2,3,5,6 modulo 7 are purely periodic. In the two remaining residues the exact Sprague-Grundy words and minimal parameters are: for every K>=1, g_{7K+4}=(0011021)^K 0011223 (021021 (0011021)^K)^infinity with (q,p)=(7K+7,7K+6)=(c+3,c+2); and for every K>=2, g_{7K}=(0011021)^K 32203103 (1 (0011021)^(K-1) 02102102)^infinity with (q,p)=(7K+8,7K+2)=(c+8,c+2). Thus both uncovered residue classes have positive minimal preperiod, completing the conjecture on the entire frozen shape.
contribution: A parameter-independent mex proof reduces the eventual recurrence to one seven-row interior table plus finitely many seam rows, proves the two proposed infinite words for all parameters, and proves minimality using primitive cyclic 2-gap words and a symbolic mismatch at q-1. Combined with the directly checked source theorem for the other residues, this settles the frozen full-shape claim. A bounded arXiv-focused search found no separate source for these exact two word families; no broader priority claim is made.
